toyota-2jz-gte.storia: Developed from the 1JZ with the stroke lengthened from 71.5 to 86 mm, it debuted in 1991 in the Toyota Aristo and powered the Supra A80 from 1993. Cast-iron block with seven main bearings, forged steel crankshaft, forged connecting rods and pistons cooled by oil jets under the crown. Two turbochargers in a sequential arrangement with an air-to-air intercooler. From 1997 it adopted VVT-i variable valve timing on the intake camshaft.
toyota-2jz-gte.limiti: The stock block and crankshaft withstand more than 700 CV. The original connecting rods are the first critical component, at roughly 700 to 800 CV. With forged rods and pistons, the stock block exceeds 1000 CV.
punti_deboli: Original sequential turbochargers with seals that become fragile after many years
Sequential system control valves (vacuum lines) prone to failure
Timing belt to be replaced at regular intervals (non-interference engine on early versions)
curiosita: The 1997 VVT-i version increases mid-range torque with the same declared power.
The sequential system runs the first turbo alone up to about 4000 rpm, then brings in the second.

versioni.nota: Limited by the Japanese manufacturers' 'gentlemen's agreement'; VVT-i from 1997

in_breve.testo: main bearings in the cast-iron block
achieved on the stock block with forged internals
introduction of VVT-i variable valve timing

affidabilita.motivo: Oversized block; known faults concern only the accessories of the sequential turbo system.

nissan-rb26dett.storia: Designed for Group A homologation: the 2568 cc displacement, multiplied by the 1.7 turbo coefficient, places the car in the class up to 4.5 litres. Cast-iron block, aluminium twin-cam 24-valve cylinder head, six individual throttle bodies and two parallel turbochargers with ceramic turbine wheels. The R32 GT-R won all 29 races of the Japanese Group A championship it entered between 1990 and 1993.
nissan-rb26dett.limiti: With stock internals the indicative limit is 450–500 CV. Beyond that, a reinforced oil pump drive, forged connecting rods and turbochargers with steel turbine wheels are needed. Racing units exceed 1000 CV.
nissan-rb26dett.iniezione: Port injection, six individual throttle bodies
punti_deboli: Oil pump drive collar, which breaks especially with a raised rev limiter
Lubrication of the rear valve train at very high engine speeds
Turbochargers with ceramic turbine wheels, fragile above stock boost pressure
curiosita: The declared output of 280 CV complied with the voluntary agreement among Japanese manufacturers; dyno measurements are often higher.
The oil pump is driven directly by the crankshaft through a collar: above 8000 rpm it is the most frequent point of failure.

versioni.nota: Steel/ceramic turbine wheels depending on version
RB-X GT2 2.8 litres, very limited series

in_breve.testo: races won by the R32 GT-R in the Japanese Group A championship
individual throttle bodies
chosen for the class up to 4.5 litres with the 1.7 turbo coefficient

affidabilita.motivo: Oil pump collar and cylinder head lubrication are critical at high engine speeds.

honda-b16.storia: First production engine with VTEC (1989): each pair of valves has two cam profiles, for low and high engine speeds, selected by a hydraulic pin that locks the rocker arms together between 5000 and 6000 rpm. Stroke-to-bore ratio of 0.96 and rev limiter above 8000 rpm. The B16B version in the Civic Type R EK9 reaches 185 CV, 116 CV/litre.
honda-b16.limiti: Naturally aspirated tuning (camshafts, intake, exhaust, engine management) exceeds 200 CV. With a turbo the stock block generally withstands 250–300 CV with suitable mapping; beyond that, reinforced cylinder liners and connecting rods are needed.
punti_deboli: Periodic valve clearance adjustment (mechanical tappets)
Oil consumption on examples driven hard at high engine speeds for long periods
VTEC solenoid gaskets and oil pressure sensor
curiosita: The switch to the high-speed profile depends on engine speed, load, vehicle speed and oil temperature.

in_breve.testo: first production engine with a dual cam profile (1989)
in the B16B of the Civic Type R EK9
rpm at the rev limiter

affidabilita.motivo: No structural defects; requires valve clearance adjustment.

honda-k20a.storia: The K family replaces the B series with a timing chain drive and i-VTEC: VTEC on the valves plus continuously variable valve timing (VTC) on the intake camshaft, with up to 50° of adjustment. Aluminium cylinder block with cast-iron cylinder liners, and no balance shafts on the 2.0. The Type R versions have an 11.5:1 compression ratio and a rev limiter above 8000 rpm.
honda-k20a.limiti: With stock internals and conservative mapping it withstands turbo builds of around 400 CV. Higher outputs require forged connecting rods and pistons.
punti_deboli: Wear of the exhaust camshaft lobes on some versions
Chain tensioner to be checked at high mileage
Valve cover gasket and VTC actuator
curiosita: The exhaust camshaft uses VTEC profiles only on the Type R versions; the economy versions have VTEC on the intake side only.

in_breve.testo: VTEC plus continuously variable intake valve timing
in the Civic Type R FD2
rpm at the rev limiter on the Type R versions

affidabilita.motivo: Robust; exhaust lobe wear on some versions.

honda-f20c.storia: Developed for the Honda S2000 (1999). FRM cylinder liners (metal fibres in an aluminium matrix) integrated into the cylinder block, chromium-molybdenum steel connecting rods, forged pistons. With 125 CV/litre it was for several years the production naturally aspirated engine with the highest specific output. In 2004 the F22C1 version lengthens the stroke to 90.7 mm and lowers the rev limiter to 8000 rpm.
honda-f20c.limiti: With a positive-displacement supercharger 350–400 CV can be reached; the practical limit is the stock connecting rods.
punti_deboli: Oil consumption if often run at the rev limiter: check the level frequently
Chain tensioner and valve clearance
Over-revving from a missed downshift on used examples: check the over-rev log in the ECU
curiosita: The rev limiter of the 2.0-litre versions is at 9000 rpm; the 2.2-litre F22C1 lowers it to 8000.

versioni.nota: 2157 cc, longer stroke, rev limiter at 8000

in_breve.testo: for years the highest figure among production naturally aspirated engines
rpm at the rev limiter on the 2.0 versions
liners made of metal fibres in an aluminium matrix

affidabilita.motivo: Robust; oil consumption under hard use and risk of over-revving on used examples.

toyota-4a-ge.storia: Twin-cam 16-valve engine whose cylinder head was developed with Yamaha, fitted from 1983 to the Corolla AE86 and MR2. In 1991 it moved to 5 valves per cylinder (three intake, two exhaust) and in 1995 to individual throttle bodies. The cast-iron cylinder block is shared with the production 4A-F.
toyota-4a-ge.limiti: Suited to naturally aspirated tuning. Above 8500 rpm the stock connecting rods become the limit.
toyota-4a-ge.iniezione: Multipoint port injection (individual throttle bodies on the 20v)
punti_deboli: Timing belt (the 20v versions are interference engines)
'Thin-neck' crankshaft on early versions at very high engine speeds
curiosita: Racing versions were used in Formula 3 and Formula Atlantic.

in_breve.testo: per cylinder on the 20v versions from 1991
cylinder head development
best-known application

affidabilita.motivo: No recurring structural defects; interference timing belt on the 20v.

toyota-1uz-fe.storia: All-aluminium 90° V8, developed for the Lexus LS400 (1989). Four belt-driven camshafts, 32 valves, cast-iron cylinder liners inserted in the cylinder block. Designed with priority on quietness and absence of vibration. From 1997 it adopts VVT-i variable valve timing.
toyota-1uz-fe.limiti: With a positive-displacement supercharger it exceeds 400 CV on stock internals. Frequently used as a swap engine because of the strength of its cylinder block.
punti_deboli: Timing belt and water pump to be replaced together
Ignition coils and sensors on very old examples
curiosita: Toyota launched the LS400 with a low-vibration demonstration: a pyramid of glasses on the bonnet with the engine running.

versioni.nota: JDM figures; export markets slightly lower

in_breve.testo: all-aluminium, four camshafts
developed for the first Lexus (1989)
arrival of VVT-i variable valve timing

affidabilita.motivo: No recurring structural defects; very high mileages documented.

toyota-a25a.storia: First engine of the Dynamic Force family (2017). Long stroke (stroke-to-bore ratio 1.18), 13:1 compression, or 14:1 on the hybrid version, high-tumble intake ports and electrically actuated intake valve timing. Toyota claims a maximum thermal efficiency of 40%, 41% in the hybrid version.
toyota-a25a.limiti: Not suited to forced induction: the very high compression increases the risk of detonation.
toyota-a25a.distribuzione: Chain-driven DOHC, electric VVT-iE on the intake
punti_deboli: Few known faults so far; isolated reports of oil consumption and chain noise when cold
curiosita: D-4S injection combines direct and port injectors, splitting the fuel according to load.

in_breve.testo: declared thermal efficiency, 41% in the hybrid version
compression in the hybrid version
stroke-to-bore ratio: long stroke

affidabilita.motivo: Few reported faults; long-term data still incomplete.

mitsubishi-4g63t.storia: Cast-iron four-cylinder with two balance shafts, twin-cam 16-valve cylinder head and a single turbocharger with intercooler. Basis of the Galant VR-4 (1987) and of the Lancer Evolution up to the IX (2007). With this engine Mitsubishi won four consecutive drivers' titles in the World Rally Championship with Tommi Mäkinen (1996–1999) and the manufacturers' title in 1998.
mitsubishi-4g63t.limiti: The cylinder block withstands over 500 CV with stock internals and correct engine management; with forged connecting rods and pistons it exceeds 1000 CV.
punti_deboli: Crankwalk (crankshaft end play) on the 1995–1999 7-bolt blocks in the Eclipse
Timing belt and balance shaft belt: failure is destructive
curiosita: From the Evo IV the engine is rotated 180° in the engine bay to reduce torque steer.
Its successor, the 4B11 of the Evo X, has an aluminium cylinder block.

versioni.nota: Engine rotated 180° from the Evo IV
MIVEC; more powerful UK FQ versions

in_breve.testo: consecutive drivers' titles in the World Rally Championship (1996–1999)
balance shafts
rotation of the engine in the bay from the Evo IV

affidabilita.motivo: Crankwalk on one series of cylinder blocks; belt failure is destructive.

nissan-vr38dett.storia: 60° twin-turbo V6 for the Nissan GT-R R35 (2007). Aluminium cylinder block with plasma-coated bores instead of inserted liners, one IHI turbocharger per bank. Each unit is assembled by hand by a single technician at the Yokohama plant. In production for 18 years in the same car.
nissan-vr38dett.limiti: The stock internals are considered reliable up to 700–750 CV. With a prepared cylinder block, drag racing units exceed 1500 CV.
nissan-vr38dett.distribuzione: Chain-driven DOHC, variable intake valve timing
punti_deboli: Coils and knock sensors with age
Oil consumption and bore wear in case of detonation on aggressive maps
curiosita: The plasma coating of the bores reduces weight and friction compared with cast-iron liners.

in_breve.testo: technician assembles each engine by hand
bore coating instead of liners
of production in the same car

affidabilita.motivo: Faults limited to coils and sensors; robust with the stock map.

mazda-13b-rew.storia: Twin-rotor Wankel with two turbochargers in a sequential arrangement, fitted to the RX-7 FD (1991). Each rotor has 654 cc chambers: the 1308 cc displacement refers to one chamber per rotor. On this site the 'cylinders' field indicates the number of rotors. Weight and dimensions are markedly lower than those of a reciprocating engine of equal power.
mazda-13b-rew.limiti: With a single turbo and suitable engine management it reaches about 400 CV with acceptable reliability. Beyond that, reinforced apex seals and modified intake ports are needed.
mazda-13b-rew.blocco: Cast iron / aluminium (side and rotor housings)
punti_deboli: Apex and side seals: compression should be measured before purchase
Vacuum lines of the sequential system: they age and cause the second turbo to malfunction
Overheating: radiator and sensors must be kept in perfect condition
curiosita: A four-rotor rotary engine, the 26B, won the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 1991 with the Mazda 787B.
Control of the sequential system uses a network of valves and vacuum lines.

in_breve.testo: chamber volume of the two rotors
valves: ported induction
two turbos that come into operation one after the other

affidabilita.motivo: Rotor seals and overheating: frequent rebuilds at medium mileages.

mazda-renesis.storia: Naturally aspirated evolution of the 13B for the RX-8 (2003). The exhaust ports are moved from the periphery to the sides of the chamber: this eliminates the overlap between intake and exhaust and reduces fuel consumption and unburnt hydrocarbon emissions. International Engine of the Year in 2003. The last production rotary used as the sole propulsion of a car.
mazda-renesis.limiti: Poorly suited to forced induction without reinforced seals; most modifications concern reliability.
punti_deboli: Low compression due to seal wear, especially if rarely used at high engine speeds
Coils and spark plugs: they flood easily if the engine is switched off cold
Oil consumption by design (the oil lubricates the seals)
curiosita: Mazda returned to the rotary in 2023 as a range extender generator in the MX-30 R-EV.
Oil is injected into the chamber to lubricate the seals: regular oil consumption is part of the design.

in_breve.testo: exhaust moved to the sides of the chamber
rpm at the rev limiter on the 231 CV version
International Engine of the Year

affidabilita.motivo: Frequent loss of compression due to seal wear.

subaru-ej.storia: Four-cylinder boxer introduced in 1989 in the Legacy, with an aluminium cylinder block and twin-cam cylinder heads. The first EJ20 turbos have a semi-closed-deck block, later versions an open-deck block. The turbo versions powered the Impreza WRX and WRX STI until 2021. With this engine Subaru won the World Rally Championship manufacturers' titles from 1995 to 1997. There are naturally aspirated versions (EJ16, EJ18, EJ22, EJ25) not covered separately here.
subaru-ej.limiti: The open-deck block is the weak point: beyond 350–400 CV a closed-deck block or reinforced cylinder liners are advisable.
punti_deboli: Cracked piston ring lands (EJ255/EJ257) due to detonation
Head gaskets, especially on naturally aspirated EJ25s
Connecting rod bearing shells and oil pickup under prolonged track use
curiosita: The typical uneven sound comes from exhaust manifolds of unequal length; from 2008 some models adopt equal-length manifolds.

versioni.nota: The most highly tuned 2.0 turbo of the family

in_breve.testo: horizontally opposed cylinders, low centre of gravity
consecutive manufacturers' titles in the World Rally Championship (1995–1997)
open-bore block on the more recent turbo versions

bmw-s54.storia: The last naturally aspirated inline six from the BMW M division (2000). Cast-iron cylinder block, high-pressure double VANOS, six electronically controlled individual throttle bodies. It reaches 105 CV/litre. The M3 CSL adopts a carbon airbox that raises output to 360 CV.
bmw-s54.limiti: Limited margins as a naturally aspirated engine. With a positive-displacement supercharger 450–500 CV can be reached while keeping the stock internals.
bmw-s54.iniezione: Port injection, six individual throttle bodies
punti_deboli: Connecting rod bearing shells: preventive replacement recommended
VANOS: pump bolts and seals
Rear differential mounts (E46 body, not engine)
curiosita: The 8000 rpm rev limiter corresponds to a mean piston speed of about 24 m/s, a very high figure for a production engine.

in_breve.testo: naturally aspirated with a cast-iron block
rpm at the rev limiter
mean piston speed at the rev limiter

affidabilita.motivo: Connecting rod bearing shells and VANOS require preventive work.

bmw-n54.storia: BMW's first high-volume petrol six-cylinder with turbocharging and direct injection (2006). Two small turbochargers, each fed by three cylinders, and piezoelectric injectors placed at the centre of the chamber. Aluminium cylinder block, cylinder head with double VANOS. Awarded several times in its category at the International Engine of the Year.
bmw-n54.limiti: With the stock turbos about 400–450 CV is achievable. With larger turbos the limit is the connecting rods and fuel pump, at around 600 CV.
punti_deboli: High-pressure fuel pump (HPFP), subject to a recall
Noisy wastegate valves and piezo injectors
Carbon deposits on the intake valves (typical of direct injection)
curiosita: Dyno measurements of stock examples are often higher than the declared output.

in_breve.testo: one for every three cylinders
injectors at the centre of the combustion chamber
first BMW turbocharged direct-injection six-cylinder

affidabilita.motivo: High-pressure pump, wastegate and injectors subject to costly failures.

bmw-b58.storia: Six-cylinder of the BMW modular family (2015), with 500 cc per cylinder like the B38 three-cylinder and the B48 four-cylinder. Closed-deck aluminium cylinder block, single twin-scroll turbocharger with integrated manifold, air-to-water intercooler in the intake manifold. From 2019 the TU version updates injection, turbo and cooling.
bmw-b58.limiti: On the TU versions the stock cylinder block withstands 550–650 CV with a larger turbo.
bmw-b58.distribuzione: Chain-driven DOHC, double VANOS and Valvetronic
punti_deboli: Leaks from the expansion tank and the oil cooler
Early units with an oil filter housing cover gasket issue
curiosita: Supplied to Toyota for the GR Supra A90 from 2019.

versioni.nota: Europe; 387 CV in the US from 2021

in_breve.testo: per cylinder, like the B38 and B48 of the same family
aluminium cylinder block

skoda-ea111-12-htp.storia: The EA111 1.2 HTP family is a three-cylinder petrol engine developed in Mladá Boleslav and produced from 2001. The first 40 kW version reached the Fabia in 2002, followed by the 12-valve variant in 2003. It features an aluminium block and cylinder head, a balance shaft and chain-driven valve gear, in SOHC and DOHC configurations. In 2014 Škoda announced that three million units had been produced.
punti_deboli: The hydraulic timing-chain tensioner may lose tension while the engine is stopped; chain jumping and rattling have been documented on some versions.
Early versions can experience high temperatures near the catalytic converter, affecting lubrication; later revisions introduced heat shielding.
skoda-ea111-12-htp.limiti: There is insufficient comparable evidence to establish a safe tuning power limit for standard internal components. Timing-chain condition, cooling and lubrication should be checked before performance modifications.
curiosita: In 2014 Škoda reported production of three million 1.2 HTP engines.
The 6-valve SOHC version preceded the 12-valve DOHC version.
manutenzione: Check for timing-chain noise during cold starts; replacement procedures depend on the engine code.
Follow the vehicle-specific service manual for oil and filter intervals; do not apply one generic interval to every variant.

in_breve.testo: displacement obtained with a 79 mm bore and 80 mm stroke
SOHC cylinder head with two valves per cylinder
introduction of the Ozon carburettor in place of the Weber

versioni.nota: Standard carburetted configuration; 75 CV at 5400 rpm according to the vehicle specification.
80 CV calibration documented for special applications; torque not confirmed.

lada-vaz-2106.storia: The VAZ-2106 is a four-cylinder petrol engine derived from the classic VAZ family. It first appeared in limited numbers in the 2103 in 1975 and was subsequently fitted to the 2106 and 2107. Compared with earlier engines, the bore increased to 79 mm while the stroke remained 80 mm. It has a cast-iron block, an aluminium cylinder head and an overhead camshaft driven by a duplex chain. In 1980 the Weber carburettor was progressively replaced by the Ozon.
punti_deboli: The lack of hydraulic lash adjusters requires valve-clearance adjustment; neglected adjustment can accelerate camshaft wear.
Oil leaks have been documented at the valve-cover gasket and crankshaft oil seals.
Failures of the thermostat, water pump or cooling fan can cause overheating and damage to the cylinder-head gasket.
lada-vaz-2106.limiti: No verified tuning power threshold is available for the original internal components. Before increasing engine speed or modifying fuelling, check valve clearances, timing-chain condition, gasket sealing and the cooling system.
curiosita: Displacement increased compared with the VAZ-2103 through a 79 mm bore while retaining the 80 mm stroke.
The VAZ-2121 engine fitted to the Niva is a separate variant and must not be confused with engine code VAZ-2106.
manutenzione: Inspection and adjustment of valve clearances are specified every 10.000 km in the maintenance schedule reported by the technical source.
Check timing-chain noise and tension, possible oil leaks and cooling-system operation.

in_breve.testo: displacement stated in the Priora owner's manual
DOHC cylinder head with hydraulic lash adjusters
introduction of pistons with valve reliefs

versioni.nota: Priora and Granta version; maximum power at 5600 rpm, peak torque at 4000 rpm.
Sport calibration; 114–118 CV depending on application and homologation.
Kalina NFR version, with specific intake and valve-train modifications.

lada-vaz-21126.storia: The VAZ-21126 debuted in 2007 in the Lada Priora and was subsequently fitted to the Kalina, Granta and some Samara 2 models. It is a four-cylinder engine with a cast-iron block, a 16-valve aluminium cylinder head, twin overhead camshafts and belt-driven valve timing with an automatic tensioner. Its design uses a lightweight Federal Mogul piston-and-connecting-rod assembly and Gates timing components. From 2018, some applications received pistons with valve reliefs to reduce the risk of piston-to-valve contact if the belt breaks.
punti_deboli: On versions built before the 2018 piston revision, a broken timing belt or seized idler can cause piston-to-valve contact.
Thermostat failures can disturb operating temperature and lead to overheating.
Unstable idle can be caused by the mass-airflow sensor, a dirty throttle body or idle-speed regulator; ignition-coil failures are also documented.
lada-vaz-21126.limiti: There is no verified safe tuning power threshold for the original internal components. Before modifying the intake, valve timing or engine speed, check the timing belt, idlers, water pump, cooling system and hydraulic lash adjusters.
curiosita: The Sport 21126-77 and NFR 21126-81 versions share the same basic architecture but use specific calibrations and components.
A piston revision was introduced in 2018 to reduce the risk of valve damage after a timing-belt failure.
manutenzione: Inspect the timing belt, idlers and water pump regularly, especially on engines built before the 2018 revision.
Hydraulic lash adjusters eliminate periodic valve-clearance adjustment; follow the oil and filter intervals specified for the particular vehicle.
